justification: Inspected gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/internal/Streams.java and gson/src/test/java/com/google/gson/internal/StreamsTest.java, plus the call site in gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/JsonParser.java. Streams is a small 169-line utility with only 3 public methods (parse, write, writerForAppendable) and one private nested Writer helper; its responsibilities are tightly coupled around JSON stream/tree adaptation, and the dedicated test exercises just that adapter behavior. I did not see excessive size, many public methods, or clearly separable responsibilities that would indicate insufficient modularization.
